integrity: The finite graph-ball normalization, active Jacobian decomposition, feasible open-cell lower witness, and critical logarithmic limit are proved in RESULT.md. The standalone Python checker is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Sharp asymptotic and explicit two-sided finite-size bounds; no exact finite-size modulus, complete equality classification, or non-star extension is established.
title: A sharp square-root crossover for fractional maximal perturbations on finite stars
